today.desc: Reverse-engineer any game, rebuild it in any engine (web, Rust, Godot) and prove the rebuild plays the same, frame by frame. Behavior specs in the open GAME.md format.
features: - It matches behavior, not looks: the rebuilds draw their own art.
- Games must be runnable and deterministic once their clock and random numbers are controlled. Network games, and games whose state cannot be observed from outside, need more work.
- Coverage is what the cases hit. Each GAME.md lists the gaps (for Dino: few crashes into the flying obstacle; for Canvas Bird: few hits on the bottom pipe).
today.trDesc: 对任何游戏进行逆向工程，在任何引擎（Web、Rust、Godot）中重建该游戏，并证明重建后的游戏逐帧与原游戏相同。以开放的 GAME.md 格式提供的行为规范。
today.trFeat:
- 它匹配的是行为，而不是外观：重建会绘制自己的图像。
- 一旦游戏的时钟和随机数受到控制，游戏就必须是可运行的，并且是确定的。网络游戏以及无法从外部观察其状态的游戏需要更多的工作。
- 覆盖率是指用例覆盖的范围。每个GAME.md都列出了差距（对于Dino：很少撞上飞行障碍物；对于Canvas Bird：很少撞上下方的管道）。

features: - CPUs: each hosted CPU is a Linux kernel thread pinned to a Linux CPU. XNU runs on it until it calls the host
- Memory: XNU gets one physically contiguous block from Linux (CMA) and manages it with its own pmap; XNU and Linux
- Devices: kexts in kexts/ give macOS a disk (a file on the Linux side), a display (a framebuffer Linux reads), a
- GPU: Metal in the hosted macOS runs on gpu/xnu-cpu-metal (metal2vulkan over Vulkan). Vulkan reaches the Linux
week.trDesc: XNU 作为 Linux 中的可加载内核模块（适用于 arm64 Linux 的 macOS 兼容层）
week.trFeat:
- CPU：每个托管的CPU都是一个绑定到Linux CPU的Linux内核线程。XNU 在其上运行，直到它调用主机

week.desc: Does GTA VI run on PC yet? A live tracker of community recompilation and emulation efforts, updated daily.
features: 1. Refreshes every tracked repo: stars, forks, issues, last push, commits in the last 7 days, and whether it's gone (404, or 451 for a DMCA block). It also hashes each README to notice changes.
2. Spots claims. If a README newly says GTA VI boots, reaches the menu or runs at some FPS, the card shows an "unverified claim" banner and the change feed records it.
4. Filters out spam such as clone networks, download lures and "PC installer" repos. Their names are counted under There is no download, never linked.
8. Records a change feed, the day's leader score for the sparkline, and a run summary.
week.trDesc: 《GTA VI》能在PC上运行了吗？社区重新编译和模拟工作的实时跟踪器，每日更新。
week.trFeat:
1. 刷新每个被跟踪的仓库：星标、分支、问题、上次推送、过去7天的提交，以及该仓库是否已不存在（404，或因DMCA封禁而显示451）。它还会对每个README文件进行哈希处理，以便发现变更。
2. 检测声明。如果README中新近提到《GTA VI》可以启动、进入菜单或以某种帧率运行，卡片上会显示“未经核实的声明”横幅，变更Feed也会记录该信息。
4. 过滤掉垃圾内容，例如克隆网络、下载诱饵和“PC 安装程序”仓库。它们的名称计入“没有下载，从未链接”之下。
8. 记录变更源、迷你图的当日领先者得分以及运行摘要。

week.desc: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
features: - Meshlet culling read its scene buffers as the wrong kind of view, so the world drew almost nothing; fixed.
- Per-draw descriptor tables could run out, after which draws used slots never made for them and the card hung; fixed.
- Light packed by the game's compute shaders was read back through empty copies (sky, probes, fog); fixed for every mip level and layer.
- The fog reconstruction, shadow-mask, hair, blend-shape skinning, fire and several material programs did not translate; fixed.
- Gathers at a named mip level (with and without an offset) read level 0; fixed.
- Implicit-level samples outside pixel shaders produced invalid DXIL in 730 compute programs; fixed.
- Rectangle lists, depth and stencil twins for depth textures written by compute, texture read-backs.
- Waits for memory values, write-watch queries and page queries no longer walk page tables per call.
- Large title buffers get a copy in card memory, with shader writes found by hashing on the card.
- Title memory can be opened as a graphics heap so that buffers are used in place instead of copied (VICTORYINPLACE, first stage only; a probe confirmed the approach on the test GPU).
- The bindless texture queue no longer uploads stale views; the view table no longer grows without bound; the pipeline library is mapped instead of read into memory.
- An intermittent device loss was traced to the pipeline library file being replaced while mapped; fixed.
week.trDesc: VIctory 的正在进行中的分支：让 Xbox Series 游戏在 Windows PC 上渲染和运行。不包含游戏文件。
week.trFeat:
- 网格体剔除将场景缓冲区读取为错误的视图类型，因此世界几乎没有绘制任何内容；已修复。
- 每个绘制的描述符表可能会用完，此后绘制会使用并非为其创建的插槽，导致显卡挂起；已修复。
- 由游戏计算着色器打包的光源通过空副本（天空、探针、雾）读回；已针对每个 Mip 级别和图层修复。 - 雾效重建、阴影遮罩、头发、混合形状蒙皮、火焰和多个材质程序未转换；已修复。
- 在命名 Mip 级别（有偏移和无偏移）处聚集读取级别 0；已修复。
- 像素着色器之外的隐式级别采样在 730 个计算程序中产生了无效的 DXIL；已修复。
- 由计算写入的深度纹理的矩形列表、深度和模板孪生体，纹理回读。 - 等待内存值，写监视查询和页面查询不再在每次调用时遍历页表。
- 大型标题缓冲区在显卡内存中获得一个副本，通过在显卡上进行哈希来找到着色器写入。
- 标题内存可以作为图形堆打开，以便就地使用缓冲区，而不是进行复制（VICTORYINPLACE，仅限第一阶段；探查器在测试 GPU 上确认了该方法）。 - 无绑定纹理队列不再上传过时的视图；视图表不再无限制地增长；管线库被映射而不是被读入内存。
- 间歇性设备丢失被追溯到管道库文件在映射时被替换；已修复。

week.desc: Paste a link, get captioned 9:16 clips in ~2 min. Free, local, open-source clipping engine (audio-first, YouTube captions, local LLM).
features: - One-click Make clips, live progress, clips appear one by one with preview and MP4 download.
- Min / Max clip length (e.g. 30–80 s). Clips end on a sentence.

- Facecam position presets (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, bottom-centre, none) for the usual streamer layouts, remembered between sessions. Or draw the face and gameplay boxes yourself in the editor.
- Caption styles: GTA Neon, Impact, Clean, Hormozi and MrBeast. Word-timed, editable words, SRT export.
- Make clips uses your own setup: facecam preset or the boxes you draw in step 03.
- Optical-flow motion + audio highlight ranking, frame-accurate NVENC export (falls back to x264).
- Nothing leaves your computer. The server binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
week.trDesc: 粘贴链接，约 2 分钟即可获得带字幕的 9:16 视频片段。免费、本地、开源的剪辑引擎（音频优先、YouTube 字幕、本地 LLM）。
week.trFeat:
- 一键制作剪辑，实时显示进度，剪辑逐一显示，并提供预览和 MP4 下载。
- 最短/最长片段时长（例如 30–80 秒）。片段以一句话结束。
- 面部摄像头位置预设（左上、右上、左下、右下、下中、无），适用于常见的主播布局，并在各次会话之间记住。或者在编辑器中自行绘制人脸和游戏画面框。 - 字幕样式：GTA Neon、Impact、Clean、Hormozi 和 MrBeast。按字计时、可编辑文字、SRT 导出。
- 使用您自己的设置制作剪辑：面部摄像头预设或您在第 03 步中绘制的方框。
- 光流运动 + 音频高亮排名，帧级精确的 NVENC 导出（回退到 x264）。
- 所有内容都不会离开您的电脑。服务器仅绑定到 127.0.0.1。

week.desc: Mirror of Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (with Claude). All credit to Levent Alpöge. Source: alpo.ge
features: - RiemannHypothesis is Mathlib's own definition (Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean, line 185 at the pinned commit), so the headline statement comes from Mathlib, outside this repository:
- src/Statements.lean (16 lines, imports only Mathlib) defines the other four statements:
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine: every zero of riemannZeta other than the trivial zeros -2(n+1) and s = 1 has real part 1/2
- DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf: for every Dirichlet character χ mod N, LFunction χ s ≠ 0 when Re s 1/2 (excluding χ = 1, s = 1)
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine: zeros of Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip lie on Re s = 1/2 (GRH for Dirichlet L-functions)
- The proof terms come from src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean:
